mono.purpose: Tabular astronomical coordinates and metrics only.

motion.name: ease-transit
motion.purpose: Hover, active, and filter state transitions.

components.name: Sync Action Button
components.description: Chamfered scarlet CTA triggering on-demand NASA TAP synchronization.
components.css: .ds-btn-scarlet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; background: #e21d2d; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e21d2d; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; clip-path: polygon(8px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 8px), calc(100% - 8px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 8px); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-scarlet:hover { background: #f02839; } .ds-btn-scarlet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7aa8ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Enamel Panel
components.description: Flat midnight-enamel workspace container framed by a 1px porcelain hairline border.
components.css: .ds-enamel-panel { background: #111f4a; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22); border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px 20px; }

components.name: Habitability Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(34, 177, 76, 0.16); border: 1px solid rgba(34, 177, 76, 0.45); color: #5ce686; }

narrative.overview: Exoplanet Explorer translates the visual discipline of an enamel-fired metropolitan transit mural into a live NASA astronomical observatory dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Matte nocturnal enamel surfaces layered tonally with 1px porcelain-tinted borders instead of drop shadows.
Four semantic route inks assigned strictly to habitable-zone physics, discovery methods, active selection, and sync triggers.
Tabular numeric alignment isolated to physical coordinates and measurements while UI controls stay in humanist sans.

rules.name: The Route-Ink Purity Rule
rules.body: Never use emerald, amber, cobalt, or scarlet as decorative card accents; each hue encodes a single scientific or operational meaning across charts, orbital diagrams, and tables.

rules.name: The Earned Monospace Rule
rules.body: Monospace typography is restricted strictly to numerical measurements, coordinates, and timestamps (tabular-nums)—never used on prose labels or navigation buttons.

dos: Do keep numeric table columns right-aligned with .mono-num (tabular-nums) and show — for missing NASA measurements.
Do disclose derived physics fields (Kepler Orbit, Derived L☉) and sampled scatter counts (Showing X of Y) transparently.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce across all transitions and skeleton shimmers.
donts: Don't add eyebrow kickers above section headings, gradient text, decorative grid backgrounds, or thick colored border-left stripes on panels.
Don't nest bordered cards inside cards or hide core catalog controls behind unnecessary modal dialogs.
